first-run.ai.title: Connect your AI
first-run.ai.sub: Your Chausar team runs on your own AI plan. Pick one now; you can change it later in Connections.
first-run.ai.codex.name: ChatGPT plan
first-run.ai.claude.name: Claude plan
first-run.ai.claude.line: Uses Claude Code on this computer.
first-run.ai.key.name: AI key
first-run.ai.key.line: A key from OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenRouter.
first-run.ai.key.hint: You pay the AI company directly.
first-run.ai.finish.codex: Finish signing in on OpenAI's page
first-run.ai.finish.claude: Finish signing in on Anthropic's page
first-run.ai.finish.line: Type this code there, then come back. Chausar never sees your password or login files.
first-run.ai.finish.lineNoCode: Finish there, then come back. Chausar never sees your password or login files.
first-run.ai.limits: Chausar sends your idea, answers and plan to the AI you pick, never your books, keys or client details. It runs on your plan and its limits. Anything that sends, posts, pays or changes a price waits for your tap.
first-run.about.title: What work do you do?
first-run.about.sub: Tell Chausar about your work, or pick a field.
first-run.about.label: Tell Chausar about your work
first-run.about.placeholder: For example: I'm a CA with six years in audit and want to do books and GST for small shops near me.
first-run.about.attach: Attach your resume PDF or LinkedIn data export ZIP
first-run.about.hint: Chausar reads only what you send. A LinkedIn export sends only your headline, summary, industry and location.
first-run.about.elseLine: Just write it in the box above
first-run.about.fileTooBig: Add a file of at most 1 MB.
first-run.about.fileKind: Add a PDF or a ZIP.
first-run.about.reply: Here is a first plan for {family}. Change anything on the right, or tell me more.
first-run.about.replyNoFamily: I could not tell your field from that. Write a little more, or pick your field on the right.
first-run.about.replyKeywords: No AI is connected, so this plan comes from templates for {family}.
first-run.about.name: Name
first-run.about.prices: You set every price yourself once the plan is kept.
first-run.about.renameHere: I couldn't rename it here. Type the name on the right.
first-run.keep.title: Keeping your plan
first-run.who.title: Which of these are you?
first-run.who.sub: Chausar shows the rules for the one you pick.
first-run.who.failed: Chausar could not list the professions: {message}
first-run.login.label: Start Chausar when you sign in to this computer
first-run.login.hint: It opens quietly in the tray, so scheduled work keeps going. Change it any time in Business, Notifications.
first-run.needs.title: Connect what your business needs
first-run.needs.sub: Each one is optional. Skip any of them; they stay in Connections for later.
first-run.needs.count: {done} of {total} set up. You can do this later in Connections.
first-run.needs.failed: Chausar could not list the services: {message}
